sample_unit: test items (40 questions and 5 complex cases)

links.outcome: Expert-rated performance of five LLMs compared on identical dental implantology questions and cases
links.effect: Gemini-2.0-flash-thinking scored highest (mean 21.9 in question answering, 22.2 in case analysis), significantly above ChatGPT-o3-mini (19.2) in questions and Qwen2.5-max (16.9) in cases.
links.quote: Gemini-2.0-flash-thinking achieved the highest overall performance, with a mean score of 21.9 in professional question answering and 22.2 in case analysis.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic and clinical question-answering performance of multiple LLMs on complex dental implantology cases and expert-scored questions, without evaluating an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
